```{r}
impact$AF <- as.numeric(impact$AF)
impact[impact$Variant_Classification != "Intron",] %>% ggplot(aes(x = TUMOR_DP, y = NORMAL_DP)) + geom_point(aes(color = AF)) + geom_abline() + theme_classic() 
```

```{r}
table(impact[impact$Variant_Classification != "Intron", "variantCaller"])
```

```{r}
# Apply filters:
# 1. For pooled normals: exclude germline peak (0.4-0.6)
# 2. For all samples: TUMOR_DP > 10
# 3. For all samples: TUMOR_MAF > 0.02 (2% AF)

impact_filtered <- impact[impact$Variant_Classification != "Intron",] %>%
  filter(
    # Tumor depth filter (all samples)
    TUMOR_DP > 10,
    # MAF filter (all samples)
    TUMOR_MAF > 0.02,
    # Conditional germline filter (only for pooled normals)
    !(NORMAL_SAMPLE == "FFPEPOOLEDNORMAL" & TUMOR_MAF >= 0.4 & TUMOR_MAF <= 0.6)
  )

# Check the results
nrow(impact) - nrow(impact_filtered)  # Number of variants filtered out
summary(impact_filtered$TUMOR_DP)
summary(impact_filtered$TUMOR_MAF)

# Visualize
impact_filtered %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = TUMOR_MAF)) + 
  geom_histogram() + 
  theme_classic()

# Compare pooled vs paired normals
impact_filtered %>%
  mutate(Normal_Type = ifelse(NORMAL_SAMPLE == "FFPEPOOLEDNORMAL", 
                               "Pooled Normal", 
                               "Paired Normal")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = TUMOR_MAF, fill = Normal_Type)) + 
  geom_histogram(alpha = 0.6, position = "identity") + 
  theme_classic()
```
```{r}
table(impact_filtered$TUMOR_SAMPLE)
```
```{r}
impact_filtered
```

```{r}
table(impact_filtered$LOH)
```

```{r}
write_tsv(impact_filtered, "pILC_IMPACT_filtered.tsv")
```
